description: Department of Labour - Special allowance payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in a specific trade, based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector administration of service conditions and benefits for workers, which is the domain of Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes). It is not about government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Commercial, etc.
